## Trigger Conditions
This error is returned by the contract when:
- `NoPendingGovernor` validation fails during entrypoint invocation.

## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Ask the current governor to call nominate_governor with the target address before calling accept_governor.

---
